rule: current net PnL <= -loss_threshold_R and maximum net MFE so far <= maximum_MFE_R and causal confirmation mode passes

confirmation_definitions.BREAKOUT: safe exit price is at/below causal breakout boundary for LONG
confirmation_definitions.VWAP_RS: last trade below causal VWAP and 5m stock-minus-0050 return <= -0.3%
confirmation_definitions.FLOW_2OF3: at least two of signed volume, large-trade flow, five-level imbalance are adverse
confirmation_definitions.ANY_1OF3: at least one of BREAKOUT, VWAP_RS, FLOW_2OF3
confirmation_definitions.TWO_OF3: at least two of BREAKOUT, VWAP_RS, FLOW_2OF3

limitations: The grid is a diagnostic comparison, not fitted production parameters.
Older 20260922-20260924 signals have no synchronized 0050; VWAP_RS cannot trigger for them.
Additional near-miss entries are counterfactual and overlap in clock time.
The 20260930 session is stitched and has four untimestamped callback errors.
Twenty-eight unique signals remain too small for production selection.
